olivia (sales): Karen on the call, running a quick POC. Calls to /v1/embeddings return 401/403 intermittently. Can we triage?

devon (pre-sales): Hi Karen, can you paste the exact error and the curl you used? 401 vs 403 tells different stories (invalid key vs authz).

karen (customer): Error body: \"error: invalid_scope (key lacks embeddings scope)\". Using curl from our test VM.

karan (typo)??: (no)

karen (customer): curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer PK_DEMO_77\" -H \"X-Org: tenant-prod-55\" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -d '{\"input\":\"hello\"}'

sam (eng): Two likely causes: 1) Token is a text-generation key (no embeddings scope) 2) Token bound to a different org and your X-Org triggers an org-scope check. Which error did you see exactly?

karen (customer): The response was 403 with that invalid_scope message.

auth-bot: token-check: PK_DEMO_77 -> type: gen-only, bound_org: tenant-prod-22, scopes: [generate, chat].

devon (pre-sales): Aha, the token is gen-only and bound to tenant-prod-22. You're calling embeddings and passing X-Org tenant-prod-55. Two problems: wrong scope and org mismatch.

olivia (sales): Karen, do you need embeddings for the demo, or can you use generate for now? Also, do you prefer we reissue a demo token scoped for embeddings and bound to tenant-prod-55?

karen (customer): We need embeddings for semantic search in the demo. Reissue would be best but we're timeboxed. Any quick workaround?

sam (eng): Quick workaround: remove the X-Org header so the service falls back to the token's bound org (tenant-prod-22) — but that won't help because the token lacks embeddings scope. So short-term you can use gen endpoint with prompt-based similarity demo, but not true embeddings.

olivia (sales): Action: we can issue a short-lived embeddings-scoped token bound to your tenant-prod-55. Devon, can you create that and give Karen a one-hour demo key?

devon (pre-sales): On it. Creating demo token...

auth-bot: issued-demo-token: EK_TMP_55030 scope: embeddings bound_org: tenant-prod-55 expires_in: 3600s

karen (customer): Got EK_TMP_55030. Running curl now...
```\ncurl -H \"Authorization: Bearer EK_TMP_55030\" -H \"X-Org: tenant-prod-55\" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -d '{\"input\":\"hello\"}'\n```

karen (customer): Response 200, embeddings returned. Thanks! :tada:

billing-bot: Note: demo token costs billed to sales sandbox org. Estimate: ~0.02 per 1k vectors during demo.

sam (eng): Followups for internal: 1) auth logs show 6 failed attempts from same IP (gen-key -> embeddings) within 2 min. No rate-limit flagged. 2) Consider improving client-side error message to recommend token scope check and show bound_org in response to reduce confusion.

devon (pre-sales): I'll add a suggested client checklist to our POC runbook: (1) confirm token type (gen vs embed), (2) confirm X-Org matches token binding, (3) ensure X-Project not pointing at another org.

olivia (sales): Karen, I'll attach the reissued permanent embeddings key to your trial if you want to continue the POC beyond the hour — and send pricing for embeddings usage.

karen (customer): Yes please — also procurement asked for our security questionnaire answers. Who handles that?

devon (pre-sales): I can own the security Qs. Please upload the form to the portal or DM me. We'll attach SOC2 and data flow docs.

olivia (sales): Recap of action items: 1) devon created EK_TMP_55030 (demo) and will follow up to issue a longer-lived embeddings key for tenant-prod-55 if Karen requests, 2) sam to open a small eng ticket to show bound_org in error payload and tweak error text, 3) devon to upload SOC2 docs to portal and reply to security questionnaire.

sam (eng): internal note: sample auth log snippet:
```\n2024-06-12T14:21:10Z GET /v1/embeddings 403 token=PK_DEMO_77 reason=invalid_scope bound_org=tenant-prod-22 header_org=tenant-prod-55\n```

olivia (sales): Great job. Karen — please ping if you want the longer-lived key. We're standing by.

karen (customer): Will do, thanks all!"
